content.title: Costco will close every single location across US for 24 hours this SUNDAY
content.text: COSTCO will close all of its warehouses this Sunday, leaving loyal shoppers with few places to turn. The retailer will close this Easter Sunday for the entire 24 hours, so all of its holiday meals will need to be picked up by then. Sign up for the Money newsletter Thank you! Costco is closing all of its warehouses on SundayCredit: Getty Costco closes annually for several major holidays, including Memorial Day, Independence Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day. This is usually done to give employees time to spend with their families. Costco’s website will still be working despite the warehouse closures, but any orders made will likely not be processed until the following day. Normal operations at Costco are expected to resume on Monday, April 6. Costco won’t be the only major retailer closing for Easter Sunday, however. It will be joined by many, such as Goodwill, Marshalls, Target, Hobby Lobby, Kohl’s, TJ Maxx, Aldi, and Lowe’s. Retailers closed for Easter Sunday 2026 1. Costco 2. The Container Store 3. Crucial services, including the USPS, will be partially frozen on Easter Sunday. Most read in Money Priority Mail is expected to operate on Easter Sunday, as well as Click-N-Ship and The Postal Store. Some retailers may be running limited opening hours. To check, shoppers should use a retailer’s online locator tool to learn the specific hours of their local stores this Sunday.
